job.title: Revenue Operations Staff Systems Engineer
job.description: Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs. We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
responsibilities: Own and engineer Arcadia's go-to-market technology stack, including Salesforce, Planhat, and RocketLane
Lead platform overhaul, data quality, reporting, deployments, documentation, user enablement, and cross-team partnership
Establish clear request and release processes for changes across the stack
Build and maintain integrations across the GTM and Customer Operations stack
Design, build, and support AI agents and automations
Provide responsive administration and support for users across supported teams
